about.text: Vodka distilled from cheese whey. A yeast turns the lactose of the whey into alcohol, which is distilled, filtered and brought to 40 %. Black Cow in West Dorset has made it since 2012.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

steps.note: Yeast ferments the lactose of whey; Black Cow does not name it, and research strains include Kluyveromyces marxianus.

steps.name: distil
steps.note: Distilled to about 48 % ABV, then cut to 40 % ABV.
Three times, once through coconut-husk carbon.

facts.v: About 0.50 g ethanol per g lactose in batch (DTU, organic whey); 34.8 g/l from 109 g/l lactose in whey powder (Tebbouche); undiluted whey at 5 % lactose gives only a few % alcohol
